findings.title: Failed-send recovery can lose reply text
findings.expected: An unsuccessful send keeps recoverable text and restores a usable Reply control; only confirmed success or explicit discard clears drafts.
findings.actual: Edge offline submit failed. Back restored the exact text while Reply stayed disabled after focus. Visiting the board and reopening the topic showed an empty textarea; no discard warning was observed. Reply count stayed 5. A later independent online submit succeeded.
reproduction: Fill a unique reply sentinel in the fixture Markdown composer.
Enable CDP offline immediately, submit; observe ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED.
Restore network, navigate Back; inspect restored text and disabled Reply.
Visit The Archive and reopen the same thread; inspect empty composer.
findings.cause: Likely mechanism: clearCompletedDraftSubmits removes pending local drafts and attempts remote discard on a later loaded page without a successful submission receipt. Latest pre-offline save acknowledgement, storage contents and successful remote deletion were not established.

evidence.observation: Edge offline submit failed. Back restored the exact text while Reply stayed disabled after focus. Visiting the board and reopening the topic showed an empty textarea; no discard warning was observed. Reply count stayed 5. A later independent online submit succeeded.

fix.proposal: Keep draft/submission state until server-confirmed success or explicit discard. Restore submit guards after failed navigation/history restoration. Preserve idempotency for an unknown send outcome. Proposal only; test each supported browser.
